subject: Evidence export procedures and operator-proof request — MediCorps SIG/SOC2
messages:
From: Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@medicorps.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: security@medicorps.com
Date: Tue, 21 May 2029 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence request — admin activity export (SIG/SOC2)

Hi Karthik,

We're working through our SIG/SOC2 evidence collection and need a clear plan for exporting Redwood admin activity / operator telemetry for an upcoming audit. Specifically we need:

- What fields you log for admin/operator actions (actor id, action, resource, before/after, session id, IP, user agent, region, timestamps, etc.).
- Retention policy for each class of event (privileged actions, config changes, session traces).
- Supported export formats (JSONL, Parquet, CSV) and whether you include a signed/checksummanifest.
- Delivery options (S3 transfer, SFTP, presigned URLs) and encryption at rest/in transit.
- Options for PII redaction or sampling (we only need operator-level events for a one-week window initially).
- Expected lead time for an on-demand export and a short sample so we can validate ingestion.

Can you confirm what you can provide and attach a small sample (with PII redacted) and a manifest format we can parse? Procurement is hoping to get proof of capability in the next few days.

Thanks,
Liam
Liam O'Connell
Security Lead, MediCorps
liam.oconnell@medicorps.com
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@medicorps.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2029 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request — admin activity export (SIG/SOC2)

Hi Liam — thanks for the clear list. Short answer: we can produce an on-demand export that meets SIG/SOC2 evidence needs and include a signed manifest and checksums. Details below; attaching a small manifest and a redacted operator trace sample to this thread.

What we log (summary):
- event_id, timestamp (UTC, RFC3339), actor_id (internal user id), actor_email (redacted on request), action_type, resource_type, resource_id, before_state (diff), after_state (diff), session_id, request_ip, user_agent, region, request_id, route, model_version, request_payload_hash, response_token_count, latency_ms.

Retention (default / configurable):
- Privileged/admin actions (configuration changes, role grants): 1 year (default), up to configurable 7 years for enterprise private deployments.
- Operator session traces / interactive console logs: 90 days by default; can be extended.
- System telemetry/aggregates: 365 days.

Export options and formats:
- Formats: newline-delimited JSON (JSONL), Parquet (columnar), CSV (for manifest-friendly summaries).
- Delivery: S3 (direct push into your bucket using cross-account role / presigned upload), SFTP (mutual TLS), or HTTPS presigned URL bundle.
- Integrity: Each bundle includes a signed manifest CSV with file-level SHA256 checksums and an HMAC-SHA256 over the manifest. We can provide PGP-signed manifests on request.

PII handling and sampling:
- We offer automated field-level redaction (masking or removal) during export. For operator traces we can provide a sampled slice (time-window + rate) or the full set with names/emails hashed.

Lead times and SLAs:
- Small sample (<= 10k events): usually available within 24 business hours.
- Full one-week export (operator-level) for a medium tenant: 2-3 business days depending on window size and retention policy.

Attachments included: medicorps_export_manifest_v1.csv (manifest schema), operator_trace_sample.jsonl (redacted sample). Also linking a short runbook in the related_links.

Proposed next step: quick 30-min sync to align S3 transfer details and the HMAC exchange flow so we can deliver the sample Monday (May 24). Is 11am PT tomorrow good?

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Reliability, Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: medicorps_export_manifest_v1.csv (schema stub)
Attachment: operator_trace_sample.jsonl (redacted sample)
From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@medicorps.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 May 2029 12:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request — admin activity export (SIG/SOC2)

Liam — adding a couple operational notes from the export team: 

1) Encryption / keys: files are encrypted at rest (AES-256). For S3 ingestion we can push encrypted objects into your bucket using our cross-account role; or we can deliver encrypted archives to an SFTP endpoint. If you prefer HSM-backed signing, we can PGP-sign the manifest using our key (we will provide the public key).

2) Checks and attestation: manifest includes per-file SHA256 and an overall manifest HMAC. We can generate an attested bundle that includes a timestamped signature and a server-side log proving the bundle creation time.

3) Timeline: we typically require up to 3 business days for exports larger than ~100k events to allow for redaction & QA. For the sample Karthik offered, 24 hours is feasible.

I'll join the sync — confirmed 11am PT works for me.

Kimberly Park
Senior Product Ops Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@medicorps.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: security@medicorps.com
Date: Tue, 21 May 2029 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request — admin activity export (SIG/SOC2)

Thanks — that level of detail helps. A few clarifications before the call:

- We'll accept S3 cross-account push. Can you confirm the IAM role ARN you will assume for the transfer or provide a presigned PUT approach?
- For the HMAC exchange: we'll generate a one-time HMAC key and rotate it after ingestion. Please confirm the algorithm and expected header format so our pipeline can verify the manifest.
- For the sample, please scrub personal emails and replace with hashed values; timestamps should be in UTC.

Procurement would like an evidence drop by Friday (May 24) if possible. If the sync tomorrow confirms the transfer details, that should be doable.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Liam
From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connell <liam.oconnell@medicorps.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 May 2029 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request — admin activity export (SIG/SOC2)

Liam — follow up after our sync; confirmed action items and delivery plan below. Attaching the small sample and the transfer recipe we discussed.

What we are delivering:
- Scrubbed sample: operator_trace_sample.jsonl (10k redacted events, timestamps in UTC, actor_email hashed using SHA256).
- Manifest: medicorps_export_manifest_v1.csv (file list + per-file SHA256 + overall HMAC).
- Transfer instructions: s3_transfer_recipe.pdf (includes cross-account role ARN, required bucket policy snippet, recommended ACLs, and post-upload verification steps).

Operational notes and timeline:
- We will assume the cross-account role ARN: arn:aws:iam::888888888888:role/redwood-export-uploader (replace 8888... with the final account id you provide).
- HMAC algorithm: HMAC-SHA256. We will include a header X-Manifest-HMAC and a signed timestamp header X-Manifest-Timestamp. Please provide a public endpoint for key exchange or paste your one-time HMAC key into the secured portal we shared in the sync.
- Target delivery for the sample: within 24 hours. Target delivery for the one-week operator export (full) pending your confirmation of the account id — expected 2 business days after confirmation.

Next steps for MediCorps:
1) Confirm target S3 bucket name and the account id for cross-account role.
2) Provide the HMAC key via the secure portal or accept our KMS-wrapped key exchange.
3) If you need additional redaction (remove IPs or user agents), tell us now — redaction is destructive and needs explicit consent.

If that all looks good I will kick off the sample export this afternoon.

—Neha Kapoor
Product Security Operations, Redwood Inference
